decision.reasoning_trace: I began by filtering out the significant number of non-speaker accessories in the feed, such as wall shelves, carrying cases, and charging cables. I then selected a consideration set representing a range of price points and performance levels. This included the high-end Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 and Bose SoundLink Color, the powerful mid-range DOSS SoundBox Pro+, and the highly portable Altec Lansing and comiso options. I ultimately decided to purchase the Altec Lansing Mini H2O because it has an exceptionally high review count of over 15,000 with a 4.4 rating, providing high confidence in its durability and sound quality for its very affordable $25.35 price.
